aboutText: RNP Electrical Melbourne has been providing expert electrical services to Brooklyn and the greater Melbourne area for years. We specialise in 24/7 emergency repairs, safety inspections, and modern lighting solutions to keep your property safe and compliant. Our team is committed to quality workmanship and competitive pricing for both homes and businesses.
servicesSubheading: Expert solutions for all your needs
servicesText: From emergency electrical work to lighting installations and switchboard upgrades, RNP Electrical Melbourne delivers comprehensive services. We handle residential and commercial projects with a focus on safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Electrician
services.desc: Fast, reliable emergency response for urgent electrical issues in Melbourne, available day and night.

services.title: Electrical Maintenance & Safety
services.desc: Professional maintenance and safety checks to ensure your property remains compliant and hazard-free.

services.title: Lighting Upgrades
services.desc: Energy-efficient LED lighting installation including downlights, outdoor, and commercial lighting solutions.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Modern switchboard installations with safety switches and RCBO protection for enhanced safety.

services.title: Commercial Fitouts
services.desc: Complete electrical shop and office fit-outs with lighting, power distribution, and data cabling.

services.title: Network & CCTV Systems
services.desc: Professional installation of CCTV cameras, data cabling, and network systems for homes and businesses.
